newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises almost four pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises almost four pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index rose 2.35 points, or 3.71 percent, to 65.69 on Monday after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index jumped 77.50 points to a provisional 2,958.65.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was higher at 14.18 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
